question.knowledge_point: Writing the Equation of a Vertical Hyperbola in Standard Form
question.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $9{y}^{2}-3{x}^{2}=54$ in standard form.
question.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $54$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}9{y}^{2}-3{x}^{2} & =54 \\ \frac{9{y}^{2}}{54}-\frac{3{x}^{2}}{54} & =\frac{54}{54} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{6}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{18} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
